英文使用 FIGlet，中文选择系统字体。在结果栏设置排版宽度、换行、对齐和字行: Use FIGlet for English and system fonts for Chinese. Adjust width, wrapping, alignment and spacing in the result panel; borders have titles and independent padding. Compare abc or the first 24 input characters in the font library, favorite fonts and import .flf files. Chinese glyphs support readability presets, weight and outlines. If glyphs are missing, change fonts or allow generation. The input font shapes glyphs; the result font arranges character art.
打开图片 → 选择列数与风格 → 转换。密度模式按字体笔画实测深浅；结构线条适合: Open an image → choose columns and style → Convert. Density uses measured font coverage; structural lines suit outlines, Braille adds detail, half blocks retain two colors. Adjust transparency, adaptive processing and palettes above the result. Automatic conversion shows a temporary preview, then the full result after adjustments stop. Cancel preserves the previous result.
每边最多 200000 字符，总计最多 4000 万采样点（Braille 每字: Up to 200000 characters per side and 40 million sample points (8 per Braille character, 2 per half block). GIF uses the first frame. Font compensation preserves aspect ratio; fixed dimensions may stretch the result. Source dimensions are estimated using the processed image and a 13 px font.
Unicode 网格：中文与 emoji 占两列，组合字符保持完整，歧义符号占一: Unicode grid: Chinese and emoji occupy two columns; combining characters stay intact; ambiguous symbols occupy one. Image preview and SVG use fixed columns; text width may vary across terminals. Tabs use four-column stops.
按所选字符编码转换为 Hex 或 Base64 字节；还原时选择相同编码和字节表: Convert the selected character encoding to Hex or Base64 bytes. Decode with the same encoding and byte format. Unrepresentable characters and invalid bytes cause an error. UTF output has no BOM by default; decoding removes a matching BOM.
按 UTF-8 字节计算 8 位十六进制校验值。CRC32 使用 IEEE 多项: Compute an 8-digit hexadecimal checksum of UTF-8 bytes. CRC32 uses the IEEE polynomial; Adler-32 uses the standard initial value. These are irreversible checksums, not encryption or secure hashes.
Base32hex 使用 RFC 4648 字母表；Quoted-printab: Base32hex uses the RFC 4648 alphabet; quoted-printable uses MIME escapes and soft line breaks. Bytes use UTF-8. Encoding does not protect secrets.
打开文件或载入彩色示例。乱码时在 ANSI 设置切换 UTF-8/CP437；经: Open a file or load the color sample. Switch UTF-8/CP437 in ANSI settings if text is garbled; classic art usually uses 80 columns. Projects preserve source text; View parses it again and replaces the result.
结果可以直接编辑。− / ＋ 和 Ctrl+滚轮调整预览，100% 恢复；Shi: Edit results directly. − / ＋ and Ctrl+wheel zoom; 100% resets zoom. Shift+wheel scrolls horizontally. Preview zoom does not change export dimensions. In narrow windows, expand input from the top.
保存项目可以继续调整原图和参数。导出选择 TXT、PNG、HTML 等格式；位图: Save a project to keep adjusting its source and parameters. Export as TXT, PNG, HTML and other formats; bitmap scale is independent. Preview comments before copying or replacing; restore the original in the current session.
使用当前字符画或粘贴文本。现代加密需要口令，可还原；摘要不可还原；编码和传统方法: Use current art or paste text. Modern encryption needs a password and is reversible; hashes are not. Encoding and classical ciphers are for conversion or learning. RSA decryption requires the matching private key. Store it safely.
传统密码仅用于教学。Caesar：整数位移；Vigenere：英文密钥；Rail: Classical ciphers are for learning. Caesar: integer shift; Vigenere: English key; Rail Fence: 2–32 rails. Latin-letter algorithms preserve other characters.
Unicode 短转义按 UTF-16 单元表示，长转义与数字实体按 Unico: Short Unicode escapes use UTF-16 units; long escapes and numeric entities use code points. Chinese and emoji are supported; invalid code points cause an error.
口令派生密钥，随机盐与 nonce；密文自带算法参数。RSA 加密使用公钥、解密: Password-derived keys with random salt and nonce; ciphertext includes algorithm parameters. RSA encrypts with the public key and decrypts with the private key. Input up to 1 MB, ciphertext up to 4 MB.
RFC 3492 原始 Punycode，保留大小写，不进行 IDNA 映射，不: Raw RFC 3492 Punycode: case preserved, no IDNA mapping or xn-- prefix. Up to 4096 input characters.
Bitcoin 字母表，不含 0、O、I、l；不附带 Base58Check 校: Bitcoin alphabet without 0, O, I or l; no Base58Check checksum. For short text, up to 16 KB of input or decoded bytes.
选择颜色范围。双色使用前两个颜色；ANSI 16/256 色会同时选择对应的终端: Choose a color range. Two-color mode uses the first two colors; ANSI 16/256 also selects terminal export encoding. Disable source colors for monochrome output.
文本按 UTF-8 压缩，标准压缩字节以 Base64 展示。还原需选择相同方法: Compress UTF-8 text and display standard compressed bytes as Base64. Restore with the same method. Decompressed output is limited to 4 MB. Compression does not protect secrets.
Unicode 规范化不可逆。NFC 合并组合字符；NFKC 还会转换兼容字符（: Unicode normalization is irreversible. NFC composes combining characters; NFKC also transforms compatibility characters, such as full-width letters. Character forms may change.
超大作品使用抽样概览；手动缩放仍为 25%–400%。文字超过 20 万单元时按: Large art uses a sampled overview. Manual zoom remains 25%–400%. Text above 200000 units is edited in pages; saving and export always use the full artwork.
自动转换先生成最多120列预览，停止调整后更新完整结果。临时预览不写入项目或撤销: Automatic conversion starts with a preview up to 120 columns, then updates the full result. Temporary previews are excluded from projects and undo history; manual edits remain protected.
Adobe Ascii85，输出含 <~ ~> 和零分组 z；还原也接受无边界符: Adobe Ascii85 with <~ ~> delimiters and zero group z. Decoding also accepts no delimiters. Bytes use UTF-8.
摘要不可还原。SHA/HMAC 用于校验；MD5、SHA-1 仅用于旧格式兼容。: Hashes cannot be reversed. SHA/HMAC verify integrity; MD5 and SHA-1 are for legacy compatibility. PBKDF2 uses a random salt each time.
自动尝试严格 UTF-8，失败后使用 CP437。经典作品乱码时可手动切换；粘贴: Try strict UTF-8, then CP437. Switch manually for garbled classic art. Pasted text is already Unicode.
最多4000万采样点。Braille每字符8点，半块每字符2点。缓存预算不含当前: Up to 40 million sample points. Braille uses 8 per character, half blocks 2. Cache budgets exclude the source image and active processing data.
密度字符表现明暗；结构线条表现边缘方向；Braille 每字符有8个点；半块双色: Density characters show brightness; structural lines follow edges; Braille uses 8 dots per character; half blocks store separate top and bottom colors.
透明像素不生成字符；颜色保留半透明度。终端不支持半透明，ANSI 导出使用不透明: Transparent pixels leave empty characters; partial alpha is preserved in colors. Terminals cannot show partial alpha, so ANSI exports opaque RGB.
FIGlet 使用字符列间距；系统字形使用每级4像素的输入字形间距。正字距优先于: FIGlet uses character-column spacing; system fonts use 4 source pixels per spacing unit. Positive letter spacing takes priority over kerning.
在设置中调整界面字体和字号；字符画字体仍在结果栏的“显示”中调整。新手模式可随时: Set interface font and size in Settings. Artwork font remains separate in Display settings. Beginner mode can be turned off at any time.
按当前字体实际笔画覆盖面积排列字符，只用于密度模式。旧项目默认沿用原来的字符顺序: Order characters by measured ink coverage in the current font. Density mode only; older projects retain their original character order.
限制生成后的字符画宽度，不含边框。开启换行后先按词拆分，长词再按完整字符簇拆分。: Limit generated artwork width, excluding borders. Wrapping splits words first, then long words at complete grapheme clusters.
最多 4 MB 输入 / 2000 行。闪烁静态显示；未知指令仅统计，不执行。: Up to 4 MB / 2000 rows. Blink is static; unknown commands are counted and never executed.
此 PEM 文件可以解密对应密文。请保存到安全位置，不要分享或提交到 Git。: This PEM file can decrypt matching ciphertext. Store it safely. Do not share it or commit it to Git.
转义序列只用于解析显示，不执行链接、命令或系统操作。修改后点击查看更新结果。: Escape sequences are parsed for display only. No links, commands or system actions run. Click View after changing the source.
生成器提供边框、分隔线和图案；文本工具可以反转、整理和处理已有字符画。: Generate borders, separators and patterns. Text tools reverse, clean and process existing character art.
TXT 保存纯文本；PNG 保存外观；HTML 和 SVG 支持颜色。: TXT stores plain text; PNG stores appearance; HTML and SVG preserve colors.
界面、转换和导出偏好将恢复默认值，设置收藏将清空，最近项目记录保留。: Interface, conversion and export preferences will reset. Setting favorites will clear; recent projects will be preserved.
中文清晰增加列数、字距和描边；混排均衡兼顾中英文；紧凑减少输出规模。: Clear Chinese increases columns, spacing and outline width. Balanced mixed text suits Chinese and English; Compact reduces output size.
将 ANSI 闪烁标志解释为高亮背景色。关闭时静态显示，不播放闪烁。: Interpret ANSI blink as bright background colors. When off, display remains static without blinking.
现代加密可以还原；摘要不能解密；编码和传统方法不提供现代安全保护。: Modern encryption can be reversed; hashes cannot. Encoding and classical ciphers do not provide modern security.
经典作品通常为 80 列。列数不匹配会改变折行和光标定位后的排列。: Classic art usually uses 80 columns. Different column counts change wrapping and cursor placement.
生成带双引号的完整 JSON 字符串；还原时也需输入完整字符串。: Produces a complete JSON string including double quotes. Decoding also requires a complete string.
现代加密使用口令派生密钥，不会保存口令；传统方法使用各自的参数。: Modern encryption derives a key from the password, which is never saved. Classical methods use their own parameters.
密钥仅保留在当前页面。公钥用于加密，私钥用于解密，请妥善保存。: Keys stay on this page. Encrypt with the public key, decrypt with the private key. Store them safely.
这里设置字符网格，原图像素尺寸会按字体换算；默认保持原图比例。: Sets the character grid. Source pixels are converted using font metrics; source aspect ratio is preserved by default.
增加字形轮廓宽度，范围0到12源像素；空心字需要大于0的描边。: Increase outline width, from 0 to 12 source pixels. Hollow glyphs require a positive outline width.
搜索已安装字体。字符画优先使用等宽字体，中文可选中文常用字体。: Search installed fonts. Prefer monospaced fonts for art; common Chinese fonts support Chinese text.
新结果已准备好。可更新当前结果并保留撤销，或保存为独立版本。: New result ready. Update the current result with undo support, or save a separate version.
新版本已保存；当前手工编辑结果仍保留。可从作品库打开新版本。: New version saved; current manual edits preserved. Open the new version from Recent projects.
0 保持原图处理。提高强度会减少平坦区域杂点并加强局部边缘。: 0 preserves the original processing. Increase to reduce noise in flat areas and enhance edges.
颜色可在图像预览和 PNG、HTML、SVG 等格式中保留。: Colors are preserved in image preview and formats such as PNG, HTML and SVG.
改变字符画的基础字号和位图导出大小；底部缩放按钮仅影响预览。: Change base artwork font size and bitmap export dimensions. Bottom zoom controls affect preview only.
12–24，标题按同一比例调整；窄窗口可从顶部按钮展开输入。: 12–24. Titles scale proportionally. Expand input from the top in narrow windows.
还没有最近项目。生成结果后点击“保存项目”，即可在这里找到。: No recent projects yet. Save a generated result as a project to find it here.
恢复项目超过 256MB，请降低字符画尺寸或输入图片大小。: Recovery project exceeds 256 MB. Reduce artwork dimensions or source image size.
每行的字符数量。列数越多，细节越丰富，转换和显示也会更慢。: Characters per row. More columns give finer detail and require more processing and display time.
一个字符的宽度除以行高，用来补偿字符通常不是正方形的问题。: Character width divided by line height compensates for non-square characters.
保留字体默认，或选择完整宽度、挤紧、FIGlet规则重叠。: Keep the font default, or use full width, kerning or FIGlet rule-based smushing.
只影响结构模式。较低值保留更多细小边缘，也可能增加杂点。: Structural mode only. Lower values retain finer edges but may add noise.
按字符画显示列宽对齐。设置最大宽度时以该宽度为对齐范围。: Align by display column width. With a maximum width, that width defines the alignment area.
控制输入各行生成的文字块如何叠放；规则重叠检查每列冲突。: Control how generated line blocks overlap; rule-based smushing checks each column for conflicts.
FIGlet 生成预设艺术字；系统字体模式可以处理中文。: FIGlet uses predefined art fonts; system fonts support Chinese.
界面、转换、导出和设置收藏已更新，最近项目记录已保留。: Interface, conversion, export and setting favorites updated. Recent projects preserved.
字距大于0时使用完整宽度；行距大于0时不进行纵向重叠。: Positive letter spacing uses full width; positive line spacing disables vertical smushing.
在生成的文字行块之间增加空行；大于0时不进行纵向重叠。: Add empty lines between generated text blocks; positive values disable vertical overlap.
编码可还原，但不保护机密。输入按 UTF-8 处理。: Encoding is reversible but does not protect secrets. Text uses UTF-8.

先裁剪和旋转，再移除透明外边缘，保留原图和处理参数。: Crop and rotate before trimming transparent edges. Source image and parameters are preserved.
解密需要对应私钥。私钥不写入项目或偏好，请自行保管。: Decryption needs the matching private key. Private keys are excluded from projects and preferences; store them safely.
最多同时打开 32 个项目，请先保存并关闭部分项目。: Up to 32 open projects. Save and close some projects first.
已保留原结果；导入对应字体或选择其他字体后可生成。: Original result preserved. Import the matching font or choose another font to generate.
实心填充笔画；空心保留轮廓。字体缺字时先显示提示。: Solid fills strokes; Outline keeps contours. Missing glyphs are reported first.
打开 ANSI 文件，或粘贴包含转义序列的原文。: Open an ANSI file, or paste its source with escape sequences.
没有匹配的设置。请清空搜索或关闭“仅显示收藏”。: No matching settings. Clear the search or turn off Favorites only.
推荐开启，让行数同时考虑图片比例和实际字符宽高。: Recommended: calculate rows from the image aspect ratio and actual character dimensions.
选择实心、细线、点阵或灰阶纹理，不改变输入文字。: Choose solid, thin-line, dot or grayscale textures without changing input text.
已恢复上次未保存的项目；保存后可更新原项目文件。: Unsaved projects restored from the previous session. Save to update original project files.
选择目标代码语言，再预览、复制或确认替换结果。: Choose the target code language, then preview, copy or confirm replacement.
仅调整应用界面，字符画字体仍在结果栏独立设置。: Changes the interface only; artwork fonts remain independent in the result panel.
裁剪区域占原图尺寸的百分比，不能超出图像边界。: Crop size as a percentage of source dimensions. Cannot extend outside the image.
项目已恢复，点击“生成”可用原参数重新生成。: Project restored. Click Generate to use the original parameters.
项目已保存，包含当前字符画和可用的输入素材。: Project saved with current artwork and available source material.
自动行数会保持比例；固定行数可能拉伸字符画。: Automatic rows preserve aspect ratio; fixed rows may stretch the artwork.
在细致的设置下显示说明，关闭后保持简洁界面。: Show explanations for detailed settings. Turn off for a simpler interface.
开启后，图片参数改变会在短暂等待后合并转换。: Merge image parameter changes into an automatic conversion after a short delay.
恢复项目已打开；检查内容后保存即可继续编辑。: Recovery project opened. Check its content and save to continue editing.
照片、插画、Logo。用密度和颜色保留细节。: Photos, illustrations and logos. Retain detail with density and color.
FIGlet 艺术字，或支持中文的字体转换。: FIGlet art or system font conversion with Chinese support.
项目已恢复，点击“查看”可用原文重新解析。: Project restored. Click View to parse the source again.
把照片变成字符画。调整滑块，细节即刻变化。: Turn photos into character art. Adjust sliders to change the detail.
调整中间亮度区域，1 表示保持原亮度关系。: Adjust midtones. 1 preserves the original brightness relationship.
加强边界附近的细节，过高可能产生明显噪点。: Enhance boundary detail. High values may produce noise.
优先行注释最稳妥；块注释会检查结束符冲突。: Line comments are safest; block comments check terminator conflicts.
当前系统不支持此方法，请选择其他算法。: This method is unavailable on this system. Choose another algorithm.
缓存：每项目64MB / 全局256MB: Cache: 64 MB per project / 256 MB total

请更换字体，或在中文字形中选择仍然生成。: Choose another font, or allow generation in Chinese glyph settings.
